verdict.rationale: Asana's developer docs list official client libraries for JavaScript and Python. There is also a v3 Node SDK migration guide covering features such as `nextPage` pagination, and the official OpenAPI spec repo underpins the API surface the SDKs target. missing for 10: official SDKs beyond JavaScript/Python, in-depth SDK reference documentation in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The official libraries available are listed below: JavaScript, Python
The v3 Node SDK supports the `nextPage` method for pagination
This repository contains the OpenAPI Specification for Asana's APIs
